scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette, clear typographic hierarchy, and layered statistical annotations (percentile lines + marginal box plot) show real design intent, but the top-earner callout labels collide in the right margin and 'Sam Q.' is clipped by the SVG boundary.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for right-skewed income data, dot plot needs no zero baseline, box plot uses correct Tukey IQR, and percentile lines are data-driven — only deduction is the hardcoded xScale domain [14000,550000] instead of d3.extent, which breaks the scaling metamorphic relation.
scores.stress_test_note: Mostly static visualization with pre-computed force layout; tooltip uses unified pointer events (no mouse/touch fight), no brush/zoom update storms, no transitions to interrupt, and no cross-view feedback loops.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4-category colorblind-safe palette, pre-computed swarm (zero animation chaos), and a clean marginal box plot keep cognitive load low; minor crowding where the subtitle text overlaps the P25/P50 percentile labels and the 5 callout lines cluster tightly in the sparse high-income tail.
